recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中散在數顆中大型母細胞，核質比高、核圓或有凹陷、胞質少量嗜鹼性，伴隨破碎細胞與血小板聚集，提示急性骨髓性白血病的循環母細胞；此放大倍率無法評估 Auer 小體或顆粒。
features: Scattered medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Round to indented or irregular nuclei; chromatin detail and nucleoli limited at this magnification
Occasional smudged/disrupted cells and a platelet aggregate
Dark stain precipitate/debris scattered over the smear (artifact)
Red cells largely normocytic without prominent schistocytes; mature neutrophils scarce in field
describe_en: Low-power peripheral blood smear shows scattered circulating medium to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to indented nuclei and scant basophilic cytoplasm, along with a few disrupted cells and a platelet aggregate. Mature granulocytes are sparse in this field. Dark granular stain precipitate is present as an artifact. Auer rods, granules and nucleolar detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of circulating blasts in acute myeloid leukemia; lineage assignment requires higher-power review, cytochemistry and flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts lack Auer rods and are MPO-negative, expressing TdT with B- or T-lineage markers on flow cytometry.
Leukoerythroblastosis shows immature myeloid cells across maturation stages with nucleated red cells and teardrop cells rather than a predominance of blasts.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and more condensed chromatin than blasts.
